open-copilot.config.title: Open Copilot
open-copilot.config.apiKey.title: API Key
open-copilot.config.apiKey.description: New API Bearer Token. This machine-scoped setting is stored as plain text in VS Code settings (and excluded from Settings Sync) and overrides a stored token. For safer storage, use [Open Copilot: Set Bearer Token](command:open-copilot.setApiKey), which uses VS Code SecretStorage and clears this setting.
open-copilot.config.baseUrl.title: API Base URL
open-copilot.config.baseUrl.description: New API OpenAI-compatible API root. Include /v1 once, for example http://localhost:3000/v1.
open-copilot.config.maxTokens.title: Maximum Output Tokens
open-copilot.config.maxTokens.descriptio: Maximum output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the provider default.
open-copilot.config.modelDiscovery.cache: How long a discovered model catalog remains fresh. Background checks run at most every 60 seconds, with an immediate check after settings changes or window focus.
open-copilot.config.modelDiscovery.inclu: Optional glob patterns; when non-empty only matching model IDs are shown.
open-copilot.config.modelDiscovery.exclu: Glob patterns for non-chat models to hide. Use exact model profiles to override filtering.
open-copilot.config.unknownModelPolicy.d: Capability policy when the server omits model metadata.
open-copilot.config.defaultProtocol.desc: Default protocol preference when the model exposes more than one compatible endpoint; falls back to an advertised compatible protocol when needed.
open-copilot.config.responses.enabled.de: Experimental: allow Responses only when the model metadata and profile opt in.
open-copilot.config.responses.store.desc: Experimental: send store=true to Responses requests. Disabled by default for privacy.
open-copilot.config.responses.truncation: Responses truncation policy. Auto is safer for long conversations.
open-copilot.config.responses.reasoningS: How Responses reasoning summaries are exposed to Copilot.
open-copilot.config.chat.includeUsage.de: Whether streaming Chat Completions requests ask for usage data.
open-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.des: Map the VS Code model ID to a remote API model ID. Useful for aliases and migrations.
open-copilot.config.modelRules.title: Model Rules
open-copilot.config.modelRules.descripti: Ordered glob rules that add or override capabilities for matching models.
open-copilot.config.modelProfiles.title: Model Profiles
open-copilot.config.modelProfiles.descri: Exact model capability profiles keyed by remote model ID. contextWindowTokens is the total; maxInputTokens/maxOutputTokens are the VS Code split.
open-copilot.config.vision.mode.title: Vision: Mode
open-copilot.config.vision.mode.descript: Vision routing: auto prefers verified native model vision, proxy describes images, none rejects image input.
open-copilot.config.visionModel.title: Vision Proxy Model
open-copilot.config.visionModel.descript: Vision proxy model used when the selected model cannot receive native images.
open-copilot.config.visionPrompt.title: Vision Prompt
open-copilot.config.visionPrompt.descrip: Prompt used by the vision proxy to describe image attachments.
open-copilot.config.experimental.stabili: Experimental: pre-activate tools to make the enabled tool list more stable across turns.
open-copilot.config.debugMode.title: Debug Mode
open-copilot.config.debugMode.descriptio: Controls diagnostic logs and request dumps. Verbose dumps can contain sensitive prompt content.
open-copilot.config.debugMode.minimal.de: Token usage only; no diagnostic logs or dumps.
open-copilot.config.debugMode.metadata.d: Privacy-safe metadata logs without prompt text.
open-copilot.config.debugMode.verbose.de: Full local request dumps; may contain sensitive content.
